name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-da-foundry-work-iq
title: Escalation Assist - post-merger support agent with Work IQ and Foundry IQ
shortDescription: A declarative agent for post-merger support: combines customer context from Microsoft 365 work data (Work IQ) with the acquired company's product knowledge base (Foundry IQ on Azure AI Search) hosted in a different Microsoft Entra directory.
longDescription: Escalation Assist is a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot built around a real post-merger problem: after an acquisition, support engineers' customer context (escalation email threads, Teams discussions, case documents, people) lives in the parent company's Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant, while the acquired company's product engineering knowledge base (known issues, fixes, release notes) lives in its own Azure subscription in a different Microsoft Entra directory. The agent combines Work IQ, the intelligence layer over Microsoft 365 work data, with Foundry IQ agentic retrieval on Azure AI Search, calling the knowledge base's retrieve endpoint through an API plugin secured with an API key stored in the Teams Developer Portal vault - so no cross-tenant Entra configuration, multi-tenant app registration, or B2B setup is required. Its instructions encode an escalation workflow: gather customer context, query the knowledge base with product terminology only (a deliberate data boundary), then synthesize a recommendation with per-source attribution.
